hypothesis: Running C8/C9/C10 submissions in an isolated `python -I` child that receives only the granted inputs, in os.urandom order, defeats R47-X1's in-process cheats.
threshold: Each of R47-X1's four cheats (AUDIT.md §3.4) must fail its checker after the fix (brief, item 1).
control_detail: Before the fix the same cheats printed FINISH LINE MET / NEW REGISTER (R47-X1 out_x1_cheat_*.txt).
result: All four fail: C7 Dracula-as-Old-Norse rejected by the label gate (JSD 0.024 to English); C8 frame probe power 0.000 at L=236; C9 frame cheat C3 7/7 but V-NULL 0/40 (seed 99); C10 old cheat 0/20 (signature) and a frame-walking cheat for the new signature 0/2 in pytest; a call-order cheat on C8 fails too. 11/11 challenges/test_heavy_checkers.py pass.
coverage: In-process frame/object reading and call-order inference.
not_covered: OS-level inspection of the parent process (command line, memory) by a hostile submission: code review remains required for credit
cross-call state inside one child (e.g. C8 shuffled-null multisets) is not blocked, only unordered

hypothesis: A GP bigram-profile distance separates an English corpus mislabelled as a new register from real other-language corpora.
threshold: tau = 0.06 JSD, calibrated on in-repo texts (disclosed in H1 PREREG Addendum 3), not pre-registered.
control_detail: Latin worked example validates (0.122 from English); X1's English-as-Old-Norse fails (0.024).
result: 15 English texts 0.014-0.049 from the English dev pool; Latin-Latin 0.019, German-German 0.017; every cross-language pair >= 0.079 (Old English vs English). Gate rejects within 0.06 of English or of a covered language other than the claimed one.
coverage: Mislabelled covered-language text with a GP-greedy-like table.
not_covered: a table tuned to move the profile
close relatives of English (Middle English, Scots) may be flagged legitimately; no Middle English text was available to calibrate

hypothesis: After R47-X1 (V-BACK closable in-house, 32/40), C9 should score only loop variants a backstep extension does not represent.
result: V-BACK diagnostic (still reported; Round 48: backstep-aware beam + re-adjudicate beam negatives). C9 scores V-NULL only (recovery gap; beams already score its key as English, -4.54; crossing changes no detection negative). Self-test seed 4711: keyskip 12/12, V-NULL 0/12, V-BACK 1/12.

hypothesis: With the key unknown (F = 65,536 splitmix64 counter keys) and printed lengths shuffled within sentence, the repo's exhaustive decoder recovers U2b plants only with true spaces, and cheap compositions of the printed-start ranker with R47-X1's segmentation beam do not reach the finish line.
threshold: H1 PREREG Addendum 3: (i) >= 0.95 control; FINISH = max(0.80, best of (ii), (iv m=64), (iv m=512) + 0.20) rounded up to 0.05; if > 0.95 C10 is not published as a heavy lift.
control_detail: (i) exhaustive with TRUE lengths: 100/100, null FP 0.0.
result: seed 4710, n=100+100: (ii) printed starts 0/100 (mean rec 0.209); (iv m=64) 78/100 (true key in top 64: 0.80, null FP 0.0); (iv m=512) 88/100 (true key in top 512: 0.90, null FP 0.0, 88.33 s/unit under 7-way load); (iii) X1 beam per key: correct key beats all 1,024 sampled wrong keys on 1.00 of 16 units (recovery 0.968), 0.2022 s/key, ~13253 s/unit for full enumeration. B = 0.88; FINISH = 1.10; FINISH > 0.95: C10 not published as a heavy lift (re-scope to Round 48).
coverage: U2b word-jump, unknown key from a stated 2^16 family, b' within-sentence shuffle, English plaintext.
not_covered: other word-indexed constructions (R41 W1-W4, G3 lagged pointers, lexicon rows)
families larger than 2^16 / clue-derived key families
(iii) measured against a 1,024-key sample, not the full family

hypothesis: R47-X1's crossing of the keyed C10 (Addendum 2) is a finding, not an error to erase.
result: Kept: with the key in hand a position-synchronous beam recovers 0.962 / 0.976 (R47-X1-C10-SEGMENTATION-BEAM-CROSSING), so the (b') recovery loss at known key belongs to the printed-start decoder. The v1 checker is preserved verbatim (in-process, so not safe for outside submissions) at H2-harden/c10_v1_keyed.py; the H2 baselines add that the same beam also finds the correct key against 1,024 sampled wrong keys on 16/16 units.
